# H lines: H_n(G; Z), n = 1, 2, ..., as cyclic prime-power factors per degree (0 = trivial), from HAP 1.62 in
# GAP 4.12.1, GroupHomology(G, n) on AlternatingGroup(5), PSL(2,7), AlternatingGroup(6), MathieuGroup(11),
# AlternatingGroup(7).

m11 H 0;0;8;0;2
a7 H 0;2,3;4,3;0;2,2,7
# R lines: p, dims of H^n(G; F_p) for n = 0..9 and minimal generators for n = 1..9, from the literature:
#   A5 mod 2: H^*(A5) = H^*(A4) = F2[u2, v3, w3]/(u^3 + v^2 + w^2 + vw), series (1 + t^3)/((1 - t^2)(1 - t^3));
#   M11 mod 2: Green-King database (users.fmi.uni-jena.de/~king/cohomology/nonprimepower/MathieuGroup_11_mod2.html):
#     series (1 - t + t^2 - t^3 + t^4)/((1 - t)^2 (1 + t^2)(1 + t + t^2)), generators in degrees 3, 4, 5;
#   M12 mod 2: same database (MathieuGroup_12_mod2.html): series (1 - t + t^2)^2/((1 - t)^3 (1 + t^2)(1 + t + t^2)),
#     generators in degrees 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7;
#   A5 mod 5: invariants of C2 acting by -1 on H^*(C5) = Lambda(y1) (x) F5[x2]: generated by xy (3) and x^2 (4);
#   PSL(2,7) mod 7: invariants of C3 acting faithfully on H^*(C7): generated by x^2 y (5) and x^3 (6).
a5 R 2 dims 1,0,1,2,1,2,3,2,3,4 gens 0,1,2,0,0,0,0,0,0
m11 R 2 dims 1,0,0,1,1,1,1,1,2,2 gens 0,0,1,1,1,0,0,0,0
m12 R 2 dims 1,0,1,3,2,3,6,6,7,10 gens 0,1,3,1,1,1,1,0,0
